heart.title: Cardiovascular & Stroke Care Guidance
heart.source: WHO South Asia CVD Risk & ACC/AHA Guidelines

doctor_tests: Routine primary care screening every 12 months
Periodic blood pressure and lipid check
eat_more: Dal, millets (ragi, jowar, bajra), seasonal vegetables, whole fruits, walnuts
avoid: Maida snacks (samosa pastry, white bread, biscuits)

doctor_tests: See a cardiologist or physician within 2-4 weeks
12-lead ECG, Echocardiogram, Fasting Lipid Profile
eat_more: Oats, millets, green leafy vegetables, unsalted nuts, steamed sprouts
moderate.exercise_target: 150 minutes/week moderate activity after baseline BP check
exercise: Stop immediately if chest discomfort or dizziness occurs

doctor_tests: Urgent cardiologist consultation within 24-72 hours
12-lead ECG, Echocardiogram, Lipid Profile, physician-supervised evaluation
eat_more: Home-cooked low-salt dal, millets, steamed vegetables, high-fiber whole grains
avoid: All deep-fried items and maida snacks
high.exercise_target: Get medical clearance first before starting or increasing exercise.
exercise: Get medical clearance first before any exercise.
Avoid strenuous exertion until cleared by a cardiologist.

diabetes.title: Diabetes & Glycemic Care Guidance
diabetes.source: ICMR Type 2 Diabetes & ADA Standards of Care

doctor_tests: Routine fasting glucose or HbA1c every 12 months
eat_more: Whole grains, millets, dal, non-starchy vegetables, fenugreek/methi
low.exercise_target: 150 minutes/week moderate aerobic + 2 days light resistance

doctor_tests: See a diabetologist or physician within 2-4 weeks
Confirm with HbA1c and Fasting Plasma Glucose
eat_more: Low-GI millets (jowar, bajra), dal, palak/bhindi/lauki, chia/flax seeds
avoid: White rice excess, maida snacks, biscuits
moderate.exercise_target: 150-200 minutes/week brisk walking + post-meal 15 min walks

doctor_tests: Urgent endocrinologist / diabetologist visit within 1 week
HbA1c, FPG, Kidney Function Test, Lipid Profile, Retinal exam
eat_more: Portion-controlled dal, high-fiber vegetables, unsweetened buttermilk, millets
high.exercise_target: 150 min/week gentle walking after physician glucose check
exercise: Check feet daily for blisters or sores

doctor_tests: Annual blood pressure check
eat_more: Potassium-rich vegetables, fruits, dal, unsalted curd, millets

doctor_tests: Physician or cardiologist review within 2-4 weeks
7-day home BP log, Serum Creatinine, Urine ACR
eat_more: DASH-style home meals, leafy greens, bananas, dal without extra tadka salt
avoid: Low salt strictly: avoid pickles, papads, chutneys with salt, chips
exercise: 10 min daily slow breathing / stress reduction

doctor_tests: Urgent physician / cardiologist visit within 24-72 hours
ECG, Kidney Function Test, Electrolytes, Fundoscopy
eat_more: Strict low-salt home meals (<1.5-2g sodium/day), steamed vegetables, dal, fruits
avoid: Extra salt, pickles, papads, salted butter
high.exercise_target: Get medical clearance first before starting or intensifying exercise.
exercise: Get medical clearance first before exercise.
Avoid heavy lifting until BP is controlled.

obesity.title: Weight & Anthropometry Care Guidance
obesity.source: Indian Consensus on Obesity & Abdominal Obesity

doctor_tests: Annual height, weight, and waist circumference check
eat_more: Balanced dal, vegetables, millets, whole fruits, adequate protein

doctor_tests: Primary care review within 4 weeks
Fasting glucose and lipid profile
eat_more: High-fiber vegetables, sprouts, dal, millets, roasted chana

doctor_tests: Endocrinologist / metabolic physician visit within 2-4 weeks
FPG, HbA1c, Lipid Profile, LFT, Thyroid profile
eat_more: Structured high-protein, high-fiber vegetarian/lean meals with millets and vegetables
exercise: Low-impact walking, cycling, or water aerobics

doctor_tests: Annual serum creatinine (eGFR) and urine ACR if diabetic or hypertensive
eat_more: Fresh vegetables, balanced home-cooked meals, adequate water

doctor_tests: See a nephrologist or physician within 2-4 weeks
Repeat eGFR, Urine ACR, Renal Ultrasound
eat_more: See a dietitian for personalized kidney-friendly Indian meal targets
avoid: Extra salt, pickles, papads, processed foods

doctor_tests: Urgent nephrologist consultation within 1 week
Renal Panel, Electrolytes, Urine ACR, Renal Ultrasound
eat_more: See a dietitian for strict sodium, potassium, phosphorus, and protein guidance
avoid: All high-salt pickles, papads, packaged snacks
high.exercise_target: Light supervised activity only after nephrologist clearance
exercise: Light walking only after nephrologist clearance

doctor_tests: Annual BP, waist, fasting glucose, and lipid screening
avoid: Maida snacks, deep-fried items, sweets, sugary drinks

doctor_tests: Physician / endocrinologist visit within 2-4 weeks
Fasting Lipid Profile, FPG, HbA1c
eat_more: Millets, dal, green vegetables, nuts, salads before meals

doctor_tests: Endocrinologist / internal medicine visit within 1-2 weeks
Full Metabolic Panel, HbA1c, Lipids, LFT
eat_more: Structured high-fiber, low-GI, low-salt Indian meals
avoid: Pickles, papads, extra salt, sugary drinks
high.exercise_target: Get medical clearance first if BP or cardiac risk is also elevated.
exercise: Get medical clearance first if BP or heart risk is elevated.
